content: मुद्गरः [मुदं गिरति गॄ-अच्] .²1 A hammer, mallet, as in मोहमुद्गरः (a small poem by Śaṅkarācārya); समधूच्छिष्टमुद्गराः <ls>Mb. 5. 155</ls>; शिलानिष्पिष्टमुद्गरः <ls>R. 12. 73</ls>. .²2 A club, mace. .²3 A staff for breaking clods of earth. .²4 A kind of dumb-bell. .²5 A bud. .²6 A kind of jasmine (said to be {%n.%} also in this sense). .²7 A particular posture in sitting.
